# What you get for what you declare

Native coverage: `make plain-presets` runs five isolated child Neovim clients with no plugin or tmux. Every preset declares applyEdit + codeAction and verifies actual initialize declarations, status rendering, draft attachment/didOpen, didChange version synchronization, cancellation, restored status, preserved unsaved draft text, unchanged HEAD/index/status/worktree and graceful client shutdown. The strict fake-editor lattice separately checks undeclared wire features; Neovim alone cannot prove their absence.

| Preset | Declared optional capabilities | Observed workflow |
|---|---|---|
| `minimal` | None beyond minimum (applyEdit + codeAction) | Readable manual-open fallback; document Abort acknowledged; no progress events |
| `showDocument` | window.showDocument | Native showDocument opens Git draft; document Abort acknowledged; no progress events |
| `completion` | textDocument.completion | Manual-open fallback and document Abort; client declares completion but server has no completionProvider (no completion offered) |
| `progress` | window.workDoneProgress | Manual-open fallback; native progress create/begin, client cancellation and progress end |
| `full` | showDocument, completion, progress, documentChanges | Native showDocument opens Git draft; native progress create/begin, client cancellation and progress end; completion declared but no server completionProvider |
